title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：zone　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 zone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the warden ① marked the zone that no resident in the centre would have noted, and he said the marking was the whole of the month. The ② zone, meaning the area itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a zone, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ zone in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ zone at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A zone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the warden said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the zone was the whole of the matter, meaning the boundary and not the area. The ⑥ zone, meaning the boundary and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; zone, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both an area and a boundary. He said the boundary is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ zone had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ zone of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of noting; zone, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ zone I remember is the area noted in the register, which closed in 1979 and is still noted as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ zone, my mother said in 1981, is the only area that improves by being noted; every zone, she said, is a boundary that has agreed to look like an area. She said the boundary was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 区域；地带（指社区中心里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 区域；地带（指那个区域本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：mark the zone 划定这一个区域
D. n. 区域；地带（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 区域之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的区域之事）
F. n. 区域；地带（指登记册里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 区域、界限（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 界限（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marked the zone that no resident in the centre would have noted

answers.why: mark the zone 意为“划定这一个区域”，1972 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记下的一个区域做了一遍。
zone 意为“区域；地带”，指那个区域本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
zone 意为“区域；地带”，指社区中心里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
zone 意为“区域；地带”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
zone 意为“区域、界限”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个界限就是那件事的全部。
zone 意为“界限”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个区域，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
zone 意为“区域；地带”，指登记册里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1977 年这一个成了登记册里的一行。
zone 意为“区域之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的区域之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记下。
zone 意为“区域；地带”，我记得的是登记册里记下过的那一个，1979 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一个。
zone 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，区域是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的区域。
